notes.title: Alpha Version 0.1.4 Released! Wilhelm scream removed!
notes.notes:
Wilhelm scream removed! 

I originally was going for funny with the Wilhelm scream but it looks like most found it just annoying. Sorry guys!  

I have removed it and replaced with a few new death sounds. 

Thanks and I hope the new sounds create a better game experience!

notes.title: Alpha Version 0.1.2 Released! New Difficulty Settings!!
notes.notes:
Just released an update to BowMage! 

The update features a choice of three difficulty levels: Cadet (easy), Mage (medium), and Master (hard).

notes.title: DEMO Released!!
notes.notes:
Just released a demo for BowMage! :)

The demo allows you to experience three action packed rounds of the game!

Click on the "Download Demo" button on the right to try it out!
